scope: Scientific method review only; independent technical preflight and exact root release still govern execution. No final PLAN existed at this review. Any change to the recorded analysis script requires a new review receipt.

findings.assessment: 232 training rows are separate from eight 11-row heldout control windows and the 11-row target, with additional five-row control buffers. The shared pooled and individual-flank templates are trained without the target or control rows.

The code labels offsets relative_raw_row and evaluates the frozen polynomial on absolute raw rows. Header metadata confirms native_pixel=4095−raw_row and argument_flip=true, so the polynomial argument is raw row. The paired original flank union is preserved; native minus-side maps to raw plus-side.

The current implementation uses a median of fixed outer pixels for each row background, followed by one unconstrained least-squares trace amplitude over the fixed inner band. It is not a joint amplitude/intercept OLS fit. Its residual sum therefore need not be zero. Signed amplitudes/backgrounds/residuals and signed training normalization are retained; failed positive normalization is an explicit failure.

Target and control data remain native detector pixels. Training profiles are interpolated onto a shared trace-centered grid and the template is evaluated back at each row native-pixel offset. This preserves observed detector compactness but the interpolated template still introduces modeling/phase dependence.

Pooled, negative-raw-flank and positive-raw-flank templates are all reported. No target-driven selection, shift or width adjustment is present. Differences between these templates should be presented as model sensitivity, not used to select a preferred interpretation.

Spatial fractions use residual L1, not the signed residual total. Signed residual sums plus explicitly positive and negative residual sums are retained. On/off-trace mean absolute residuals per pixel are included, which clarifies unequal pixel area. Off-trace fraction alone is not evidence of a deposit.

Amplitude/background/outer-MAD context accompany the controls. Empirical comparisons are explicitly not probabilities, classifiers or photon fractions. Only model inadequacy/localization may be described; trace-aligned charge may be absorbed and a compact residual need not imply artifact-only origin.

Training and target/control failures are retained as blocked records. All three declared templates and all nine window slots remain accounted; no successful-only template selection or replacement control occurs.

background_caveat: Nearest B trace lies +16.3539382732 pixels from A at the target row. The positive background samples near A+9…12 approach the B trace to approximately 4.4…7.4 pixels. No B-array values were read; contamination is unknown. Separate negative/positive outer medians are now prespecified for training and evaluated rows. Use them to describe background asymmetry; do not invent a target-driven correction. Outer samples remain an estimator, not demonstrated pure bias/sky.
remaining_report_guards: Do not equate a large residual or empirical rank with a charge classification.
Do not treat low residuals as proof of photons or derive a physical charge/photon fraction.
No calibrated error model, independent replicate or physical-origin assignment is supplied by this one-exposure/order diagnostic.
Keep the frozen target, controls, failed diagnostics, original extraction and U label unchanged.
